portrait.welcome: Tap “Fly the last ferry” to begin.
portrait.glide: LOW: you can't glide to the strip. Motor 100% (R) to climb.
portrait.low: LOW: you can't glide to the strip. Motor 100% (R) to climb.
portrait.stall: Stalling: nose down (− / S) until below 14.9°.

lab.start: Tap “Start flying”, then set the nose with − / +; 4° glides best.
